title: LagFree
description: A lightweight lag-fixing plugin for Paper/Spigot that clears items and stabilizes TPS.
body:
# 🚀 AddaLagFree - High-Performance Server Optimizer
AddaLagFree is a lightweight yet powerful utility plugin designed specifically for Paper, Spigot, and Purpur servers. It focuses on maintaining high TPS (Ticks Per Second) and providing a smooth, lag-free experience for your players.

✨ Key Features:
🗑️ Smart Auto-Clear: Automatically removes dropped items every 5 minutes to prevent entity buildup and RAM spikes.

⚡ Network Optimization: Optimizes server-to-client packets to reduce "Ghost Lag" and improve hit detection.

📶 Real-time Ping Utility: Allows players to check their current latency with a clean, color-coded chat interface.

🍃 Zero Overhead: Built with efficient code to ensure the plugin itself consumes negligible CPU and RAM resources.

🛠️ Commands & Permissions:
Command	Description	Permission
/ping	Check your current connection latency.	None (Default)
/ilaj	Instantly restores Health and Hunger.	op
📥 Installation Guide:
Download the .jar file compatible with your server version.
